# Sources and test limits

version: October 23, 2026. No tariff prices, product comparisons by hearsay or claimed export loyalty.

## SRC-01 · Transkribus: Downloading

[Transkribus: Downloading](https://help.transkribus.org/downloading)

**Use:** PAGE XML and TEI as export options; TEI selection standard and Page2tei. No claim derived from the documentation of loss-free project-specific genetics.

**Test stand:** Documentation read; no export practically tested.

## SRC-02 · oXygen: Git Client

[oXygen: Git Client](https://www.oxygenxml.com/doc/ug-addons/git-client/git-addon.html)

**Use:** Add-on allows local version work and collaboration with a remote repo.

**Checkstand:** Read documentation; no oXygen installed or institutional workflow tested.

## SRC-03 · Git: Industries in a Nutshell

[Git: Industries in a Nutshell](https://git-scm.com/book/en/v2/Git-Branching-Branches-in-a-Nutshell)

**Use:** Branches as parallel versions.

**Test stand:** Official Git documentation read.

## SRC-04 · GitLab: Forks

[GitLab: Forks](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/forking_workflow/)

**Use:** Fork as its own connected project; rights and visibility rules must be reviewed.

**Test stand:** Official documentation read; local university configuration open.

## SRC-05 · IIIF Presentation API 3.0

[IIIF Presentation API 3.0](https://iiif.io/api/presentation/3.0/)

**Use:** Canvas for page/view; region as addressable section.

**Test stand:** Specification read; no real image endpoints set up.

## SRC-06 · Patrick Sahle: What is a Scholarly Digital Edition? (2016)

[Patrick Sahle: What is a Scholarly Digital Edition? (2016)](https://www.openbookpublishers.com/books/10.11647/obp.0095/chapters/10.11647/obp.0095.02)

**Use:** Original contribution identified: pp. 19-40, DOI 10.11647/OBP.0095.02.

**Test state:** Publisher metadata checked. Chapter full text blocked when retrieved by bot verification; no verified literal quotations or sales references.

## SRC-07 · TEI P5: Representation of Primary Sources

[TEI P5: Representation of Primary Sources](https://tei-c.org/release/doc/tei-p5-doc/en/html/PH.html)

**Use:** Genetic markup and source reference; add, del and later facsimileankers expertly examine.

**Test stand:** Official pages not accessible when retrieved. TEI/ODD validation and exact model decision remain open.

The professional stories are elaborated. Practical export comparison, ODD/TEI validation, IIIF demo page, front-end test and legal embedding of actually used agreements are still pending. These tasks do not prevent the editorial test bench; they prevent corresponding technical or legal disclosure claims.


## Sources for early publication

[Kumulative Dissertation · Faculty of Humanities Göttingen](https://www.uni-goettingen.de/de/689605.html) · Ein Beispiel auch für Neuere deutsche Literatur und Digital Humanities. Die Anforderungen entscheiden Publikationsfähigkeit und individuelle Beiträge; bestimmlich ist die jegenden Promotionordnung.

[Zenodo · DOI Versioning](https://zenodo.org/help/versioning) · Versions DOIs reference a specific output; an overarching DOI can represent all versions.

Call: 23 October 2026. The faculty information serves as an example of existing cumulative doctoral possibilities; their concrete requirements are not asserted for the fictitious project.

## Edition term and frontend

[Sahle, Vogeler et al.: Criteria for Reviewing Scholarly Digital Editions, Version 1.1](https://www.i-d-e.de/publikationen/weitereschriften/criteria-version-1-1/) describes digital editions as scientific information systems under a digital paradigm. In our case we distinguish the scientifically responsible TEI inventory and its development in the front end. This is a concrete model decision of the project, not a claim that Sahle equates digital editions generally with TEI files.
